title: Demon Blacksmith
description: A muscular red and green demon with large blue wings kneels while holding a glowing green hammer in one hand and touching a red anvil with the other. The scene shows an open dark door with purple light behind it, scattered books and coins on the floor, and dramatic smoke filling the space.
prompt: A muscular demon with red and green skin and large blue wings kneels in a smoky room. He holds a glowing green hammer in his right hand and touches a red anvil with his left hand. His body shows cracks of orange light. An open dark wooden door with purple light stands behind him. Scattered books coins and papers cover the floor. The air is filled with green red and white smoke.
